name: Media Downloader
description: Browser-side bridge between Jellyfin and the DownloaderWeb engine: the plugin keeps the engine key server-side, queues download jobs exactly once (outbox), and surfaces engine health/queue in the dashboard.
overview: Queues movies, series and anime for the DownloaderWeb engine and shows its health and queue.

versions.changelog: Fix double-encoded JSON responses (Health, Libraries, Outbox were returning JSON strings instead of objects, so the plugin UI showed offline despite a 200 response)
Fix Test-connection 500: register MediaDownloaderPlugin in the DI container (it was injected into the controller but never registered, so every action 500'd). Added E4 regression test.
Plugin now appears in the dashboard sidebar: 'Media Downloader' (settings) and 'Media Downloader Overview' (queue/download screen). Includes all prior fixes; install 12.1.0.6 on Jellyfin 12.1.
Fix: plugin API endpoints were 500ing (OutboxWorker DI registration) - Test connection / settings now work. Includes all prior fixes; install 12.1.0.5 on Jellyfin 12.1.
Builds the 12-line against Jellyfin 12.1 (targetAbi 12.1.0.0). Includes the startup crash fix from build 3. Install 12.1.0.4 on Jellyfin 12.1.
Fix startup NullReferenceException: plugin instance is now resolved lazily in the DI factories (with an IApplicationPaths fallback for the outbox folder). Installs cleanly on 10.10/10.11/12.
Add Verify drives: engine write+read round-trip per folder, plugin MediaDownloader/Verify proxy, Settings button. Same-letter (zero pathMappings) is now the documented primary setup.
